protocol: research_v3 stock_mf: A-share individual-stock 4-factor (price/volume only) strategy for a 20,000-30,000 CNY account
relation: Satellite strategy, independent of the frozen CAP_DEF_M core. Feasibility facts: research_v3/stock_mf/feasibility/FEASIBILITY.md (no factor or strategy returns were computed there).

data.listed_stocks: THS per-stock daily bars from 2005-01 (prices/historical) and THS market dumps (daily-k, adjustment factors); adjusted with the THS adjustment factors
data.delisted_stocks: akshare stock_zh_a_hist_tx (Tencent, hfq) for every code in akshare stock_info_sh_delist + stock_info_sz_delist; single unofficial source, declared bias
data.shares: Eastmoney share-structure history (akshare stock_zh_a_gbjg_em) for total and float shares, as-of dated; if missing for a date, last known value before it
data.benchmarks: CSI 1000 (000852) and CSI 500 (000905) price indices from THS or akshare; price indices (no dividends), declared
data.no_financial_statements: No accounting data is used anywhere (restated values and missing original dates make it non point-in-time).

universe.schedule: rebuilt at each month-end close, used for the following month
eligibility: A-share common stock on SSE main board, SZSE main board, ChiNext or STAR
at least 250 sessions of bars before the date
has a bar with volume > 0 on the date
universe.ranking: composite rank = mean of (rank by float market cap, rank by 60-session mean turnover amount), both descending; keep the top 1000
universe.inferred_ST: a stock is flagged on a date if within the previous 60 sessions it has at least one session closing at a +/-5% limit (|close/prev_close - 1| between 4.85% and 5.15% with close == high for up or close == low for down) and no session with |return| > 5.5%; declared approximation because dated ST history is unavailable for Shanghai

factors.REV: minus the 20-session total return ending at the signal close
factors.LOWVOL: minus the standard deviation of the last 60 daily returns
factors.LOWTURN: minus the mean daily turnover rate (volume / float shares) over the last 20 sessions
factors.SIZE: minus log(float market cap) at the signal close
factors.processing: computed only from data dated on or before the signal close; each factor winsorised at the 1st/99th cross-sectional percentiles, then z-scored across the universe; composite = equal-weight mean of the four z-scores; a stock missing any factor is skipped
factors.no_tuning: Windows, weights and factor list are fixed here and never changed.

portfolio.rebalance: every second weekly signal (last session of every other week, starting from the first eligible week of the development period); trades at the next session open
portfolio.selection: target = top 10 by composite; an existing holding is kept if its composite rank is <= 20 and it is still in the universe; remaining slots filled by the best-ranked non-held stocks
portfolio.weights: equal weight 1/10 of portfolio value per stock
portfolio.affordability: at the 25,000 CNY account, a stock is skipped at selection if one board lot (100 shares; 200 for STAR) costs more than 2,500 CNY at the signal close

execution_model.t_plus_1: no sale on the day of purchase
execution_model.price_limits: 10% main board; ChiNext 10% before 2020-08-24 and 20% from 2020-08-24; STAR 20%; inferred-ST 5%; first 5 sessions after listing are irrelevant (250-session rule)
execution_model.blocked_orders: cannot buy if open >= up-limit; cannot sell if open <= down-limit or no bar (suspended); blocked orders retry at each following open until the next rebalance replaces them
execution_model.delisting: a holding that stops trading permanently is valued at its last close and converted to cash at that value on the delisting date (declared optimistic simplification)

costs.slippage: 10 bp per side; sensitivity 20 bp per side

accounts.SMALL: 25,000 CNY, 100-share lots (200 for STAR), leftover cash earns SHIBOR (decision version)
accounts.LARGE: 1,000,000 CNY, fractional shares (reported, shows the strategy without lot effects)

periods.holdout: 2024-04-01 to 2026-09-30; must not be loaded, scored, plotted or summarised before a one-time run authorised by the user in chat after the development verdict; enforced by a code guard with an authorisation file and a one-time state file

benchmarks.EW_UNIVERSE: equal weight across the whole 1000-stock universe, rebalanced on the same biweekly sessions, same costs, LARGE account

metrics: stationary block bootstrap (block 21, 2000 resamples, seed 20261019) 90% CI of excess Sharpe difference vs EW_UNIVERSE and vs CSI1000

decision_on_development.version: SMALL account, NO_MIN commission, 10 bp slippage
PASS_if_all: DEV excess Sharpe > EW_UNIVERSE and > CSI1000
excess Sharpe > EW_UNIVERSE in DEV_A and in DEV_B
DEV max drawdown < EW_UNIVERSE DEV max drawdown
first condition still holds at 20 bp slippage
decision_on_development.user_tolerance_note: The user accepts a 30-40% drawdown; report whether DEV max drawdown is within 40%, but it is not a pass condition (a long-only small-cap A-share portfolio is expected to exceed it in 2015).
decision_on_development.if_PASS: ask the user in chat for the one-time holdout run
decision_on_development.if_FAIL: report; holdout not run unless the user asks for information only

declared_biases: delisted prices from a single unofficial source
float-share history gaps filled with last known value
freeze_rule: Frozen at commit time; any change is a separately labelled amendment written before the affected run.
